questions.question: Explain why De Klerk unbanned the liberation movements in 1990.
questions.expected_answer: De Klerk: NP leader February 1989, State President September 1989. Reasons: internal crisis (uprisings, MDM defiance, emergencies costly and not decisive); economy (sanctions, disinvestment, loans refused, war costs, low growth, unemployment, business pressure); international change (Berlin Wall November 1989, Soviet support reduced, Namibia March 1990); secret talks (Mandela met Botha July 1989, De Klerk December 1989; Sisulu released October 1989). Debate: pragmatism and negotiating from strength versus courage and change of heart.

questions.question: Describe the speech of 2 February 1990 and Mandela's release.
questions.expected_answer: 2 February 1990, opening of Parliament: ANC, PAC, SACP and other organisations unbanned; UDF, COSATU restrictions lifted; non-violent political prisoners released; media restrictions lifted; death penalty suspended; Mandela to be released unconditionally; call to negotiate. Reactions: astonishment; CP and AWB (Terre'Blanche) opposed; celebration and caution. Mandela: arrested 1962, life sentence 1964 (Rivonia); Robben Island 18 years, Pollsmoor from 1982, Victor Verster from December 1988; rejected 1985 conditional offer. 11 February 1990: walked out with Winnie, fist raised; City Hall balcony speech ("humble servant"; armed struggle continues; call to whites); 13 February FNB Stadium rally.

questions.question: Explain the release of other prisoners, the return of exiles and the first agreements.
questions.expected_answer: Govan Mbeki 1987; Sisulu, Kathrada, Mhlaba, Mlangeni, Motsoaledi, Mkwayi, Masemola October 1989; more releases after 1990, disputes about who was political. Exiles: Tambo returned December 1990; Mbeki, Hani; UNHCR; problems of work, housing, indemnity. Groote Schuur Minute 4 May 1990; Pretoria Minute 6 August 1990 (armed struggle suspended); emergency lifted June 1990, Natal October 1990. Repeal: Separate Amenities Act 1990; Group Areas Act, Land Acts, Population Registration Act June 1991; still no vote.
